record.paper_title: Open Problems for Entire Functions of Bounded Index in Direction
record.original_question: Fix a direction b and an entire function F on C^n with positive continuous L. For each base point z0, define the one-variable slice g_z0(t) = F(z0 + tb) and the slice weight l_z0(t) = L(z0 + tb). What minimal requirements on a set A of base points are enough to ensure that the global directional index N_b(F,L) equals max{N(g_z0,l_z0) : z0 in A}, where N(g_z0,l_z0) is the one-variable l_z0-index of the slice?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbf{b}\in\mathbb{C}^n\setminus\{0\}$ be a fixed direction, let $F:\mathbb{C}^n\to\mathbb{C}$ be an entire function, and let $L:\mathbb{C}^n\to(0,\infty)$ be a continuous positive function. For each $z_0\in\mathbb{C}^n$ define the one-variable slice $g_{z_0}:\mathbb{C}\to\mathbb{C}$ and slice weight $l_{z_0}:\mathbb{C}\to(0,\infty)$ by
$$g_{z_0}(t)=F(z_0+t\mathbf{b}),\qquad l_{z_0}(t)=L(z_0+t\mathbf{b}).$$
Recall that for a (nonconstant) entire function $g$ of one variable and a positive continuous weight $l$, the $l$-index $N(g,l)$ is the least nonnegative integer $m$ (if any) such that for every $t\in\mathbb{C}$,
$$\frac{|g^{(k)}(t)|}{k!\,l(t)^k}\le \max_{0\le j\le m}\frac{|g^{(j)}(t)|}{j!\,l(t)^j}\qquad\text{for all }k\ge 0,$$
and the directional $L$-index $N_{\mathbf{b}}(F,L)$ is the least nonnegative integer $m$ such that for every $z\in\mathbb{C}^n$,
$$\frac{1}{k!\,L(z)^k}\Big|\frac{\partial^k F}{\partial \mathbf{b}^k}(z)\Big|\le \max_{0\le j\le m}\frac{1}{j!\,L(z)^j}\Big|\frac{\partial^j F}{\partial \mathbf{b}^j}(z)\Big|\qquad\text{for all }k\ge 0,$$
where $\partial F/\partial\mathbf{b}$ denotes the directional derivative along $\mathbf{b}$.

Determine the minimal conditions on a subset $A\subset\mathbb{C}^n$ of base points that guarantee
$$N_{\mathbf{b}}(F,L)=\sup\{\,N(g_{z_0},l_{z_0}):z_0\in A\,\}.$$
In other words, find the weakest geometric/measure-theoretic requirement on $A$ ensuring that the global directional $L$-index of $F$ can be recovered as the supremum of the one-variable $l_{z_0}$-indices of its slices along $\mathbf{b}$ over base points in $A$.
artifact.category_tag: Entire functions of bounded L-index in direction
artifact.status_search_result: The question is listed as an explicit open problem in a survey of open problems on entire functions of bounded index in direction. Subsequent literature by Bandura and collaborators on slice holomorphic functions of bounded L-index in direction develops sufficient conditions involving slices but does not appear to give a definitive characterization of the minimal admissible set A; no source found that resolves the minimality question.

status_evidence.title: Slice Holomorphic Functions in Several Variables with Bounded L-Index in Direction
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces and studies boundedness of L-index in direction via one-variable slices but does not resolve the minimal-set question.
status_evidence.claim: Related work develops slice criteria but the minimality of A appears unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Some criteria of boundedness of the L-index in direction for slice holomorphic functions
status_evidence.snippet: Presents criteria of boundedness via slice indices.
status_evidence.claim: Provides sufficient slice-based criteria, not a minimal characterization.
